narration: We begin with the motion frames: a short sequence of video frames showing the speaker's head pose and movement.
Next comes the identity frame, a single reference image that fixes who the person is.
Third is the noisy target, the corrupted version of the frame the model must learn to denoise.
These three visual inputs are routed together and combined at a summation junction into one conditioning signal.
In parallel, the speech waveform is passed through an audio encoder, producing the audio conditioning features.
Both the combined visual input and the audio features feed the diffusion model, which also receives a time encoding for the current denoising step.
The diffusion model outputs the target frame: the same identity, driven by the motion and synchronized to the speech.
